parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The token that is used to retrieve the next page of results.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The ID of the region in which you want to query the logs of the execution.

parameters.name: TaskExecutionId
parameters.description: The execution ID of the task.
